terms.gloss: bunch of flowers, nosegay; small bundle
evidence: Cic. Tusc. 3.43: fasciculum ad nārēs admovēbis? (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: A little bundle (fascis): of letters, books, flax, and so of flowers held to the nose. flōrum fasciculus (Morgan–Owens) makes the sense plain.

phrases.english: Give this bunch of flowers to Mummy.

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. bouquet (bunch of flowers).
